title: Ben Yehotzadak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:4, boasting of his leaps (he would leap and dance at the Simchat Beit HaSho’evah).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Guggenheimer text of Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:4 explicitly says that Ben Yehotzadak boasted of his leaps. Hyman’s parenthetical explanation of leaping and dancing at the Simchat Beit HaSho’evah is retained as his explanation; the other performers and episodes in that paragraph are not part of this notice.
